MCP Integration

Zeo implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a first-class integration layer. The MCP server exposes CLI capabilities as structured tools that can be invoked by any MCP-compatible client, with full determinism and evidence guarantees.

Capabilities

Protocol Handshake

Standardized MCP handshake with version negotiation, capability discovery, and connection health monitoring.

Tool Registration

CLI tools are registered as MCP-callable actions. Each tool declares its input schema, output contract, and side-effect profile.

Session Isolation

Each MCP session operates in an isolated context with scoped credentials. No shared mutable state between sessions.

Deterministic Responses

MCP tool invocations return deterministic results with evidence hashes. Responses are reproducible across identical inputs.

Protocol Details

Protocol VersionMCP v1.0
Transportstdio / HTTP
AuthToken-scoped per session
Health CheckHeartbeat every 2s
Tool CountDynamic (registry-based)
EvidenceSHA-256 attestation per call

Architecture Boundary

The MCP server package (@zeo/mcp-server) is a standalone process. It does not import from the marketing frontend or share runtime state with the web application. Communication happens exclusively through the MCP protocol layer.

Confidence range, assumptions, provenance, and sensitivity first.
